    # Determine motif by selecting non-background cells in the topmost row(s) before isolated markers.
    mr = min(r for r,c,v in cells)
    motif_cells = [(r,c,v) for r,c,v in cells if r <= mr]

    if not motif_cells:

    # Isolated marker pixels are the remaining color-3 cells, stamped at their coordinate origin.
    marks=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==3]
    for r,c in marks:
        for dr,dc,v in motif:
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]

    seen=set(); comps=[]

        q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]

          for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]!=bg and (yy,xx) not in seen:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
        comps.append(comp)
    motif=max(comps,key=len); ar=min(y for y,x,v in motif); ac=min(x for y,x,v in motif)
    rel=[(y-ar,x-ac,v) for y,x,v in motif]
    # Marker positions are cells that belong to singleton components, other than source.
    for comp in comps:
      if comp is motif or len(comp)!=1: continue
      r,c,color=comp[0]
      # Anchor is at the motif's unique cell of the same color if present; otherwise top-left.
      same=[(dy,dx) for dy,dx,v in rel if v==color]
